annotations.text:
WORKING — settled.

Tap any tile. The detail underneath is the worker's own field set: sub-skills, level, years, proof, working mode. Nothing here has a headcount or a clock.

HIRING — Direction A: shaped by business type.

Ratna Cafe sees kitchen and service needs first. Tap a tile for the hirer's field set: headcount, shift window, requirement bar, standby, repeat.

HIRING — Direction B: one universal list.

Four tiles for every hirer, then a step that narrows to a trade. Tap 'Cover a shift' to see the extra step it costs.
The tiles look alike on purpose — same 16px card, same 44px icon tile. What differs is the noun, the number on the face, and every field behind it.
